question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Delegate
solution:
The correct answer is **"Representative."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Delegate"** means a person who has been chosen to speak or take decisions for a group of people, especially at a meeting. (किसी सम्मेलन में समूह की ओर से निर्णय लेने या बोलने के लिए चयनित व्यक्ति, प्रतिनिधि)

 
 
• **Example**: ***Delegates**__ have voted in favour of the motion.*
 
 
 
• **"Representative"** means a person who is chosen or elected to act or speak on behalf of others. (व्‍यक्ति या वर्ग का प्रतिनिधि)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The firm has **representatives**__ in every major city.*
 
 
 
• The two words are synonymous in the context of assigning tasks or responsibilities to someone else.
 
• The correct answer is option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Serviceman"** refers to a person who is employed in the armed forces or in any other service-oriented profession. (सशस्‍त्र पुरुष सैनिक)
 
• **"Elect"** means to choose or select someone for a particular position or honor. (मतदान के द्वारा (किसी को) निर्वाचित करना या चुनना)
 
• **"Exemplar"** means a person or thing serving as a typical or excellent example of something. (किसी चीज़ का विशिष्ट या उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण के रूप में कार्य करने वाला व्यक्ति या चीज़)
